title: 49 Chinese Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Chinese for Beginners (Feelings & Emotions)
description:
Learn 49 essential Chinese phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Chinese #LearnChinese #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 中文, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Chinese with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 49 real-life phrases
- 中文 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Feelings & Emotions · 感受与情绪
1:29  Asking for Directions · 问路
2:53  Perseverance · 毅力
4:10  Mindfulness · 正念
5:26  Hobbies & Free Time · 爱好与休闲
6:50  Inner Peace · 内心平静
8:06  Self Improvement · 自我提升
9:26  Daily Routine · 日常生活

PHRASE LIST

FEELINGS & EMOTIONS · 感受与情绪
• I feel stressed in my chest. - 我胸口有点堵，压力很大。  [Wǒ xiōngkǒu yǒudiǎn dǔ, YN DÀLǐi HĔN DÀ.]
• I’m quietly excited about tonight. - 今晚我有点偷偷期待，心里暖暖的。  [Jīnwǎn wǒ yǒudiǎn tōutōu qīdài, xīnli nuǎn nuǎn de.]
• That made my mood lift. - 你一说，我的心情就好多了。  [Nǐ yì shuō, wǒ de xīnqíng jiù hǎo duō le.]
• I can’t shake this worry. - 这份担心挥之不去。  [Zhè fèn dānxīn huī zhī bù qù.]
• I’m feeling lonely right now. - 我现在有点孤单，想找个人聊聊。  [Wǒ xiànzài yǒudiǎn gūdān, xiǎng zhǎo gèrén liáo liáo.]
• I feel grateful for your patience. - 谢谢你这么有耐心，我真的很感激。  [Xièxie nǐ zhème yǒu nàixīn, wǒ zhēn de hěn gǎnjī.]

ASKING FOR DIRECTIONS · 问路
• Sorry, I missed that turn. - 不好意思，我刚才没听清转弯。  [bù hǎo yì si, wǒ gāng cái méi tīng qīng zhuǎn wān]
• Where’s the entrance, exactly? - 入口在哪里，具体点。  [rù kǒu zài nǎ lǐ, jù tǐ diǎn]
• Can I go straight for now? - 我现在可以先一直走吗？  [wǒ xiàn zài kě yǐ xiān yì zhí zǒu ma]
• Is it better to take stairs? - 上楼走楼梯更方便吗？  [shàng lóu zǒu lóu tī qìng gèng fāng biàn ma]
• Do I cross the street now? - 我现在要过马路吗？  [wǒ xiàn zài yào guò mǎ lù ma]
• What’s the landmark after this? - 接下来经过什么地标？  [jiē xià lái jīng guò shén me dì biāo]
• Is there a bus stop nearby? - 附近有公交站吗？  [fù jìn yǒu gōng jiāo zhàn ma]

PERSEVERANCE · 毅力
• Hard day, keep training. - 再难也继续练。  [zài nán yě jìxù liàn]
• Make it through, one minute at a time. - 先熬过去, 再说后面的。  [xiān áo guò qù, zài shuō hòu miàn de]
• Set a timer, then don’t quit. - 定个闹钟, 时间到了再停。  [dìng gè nào zhōng, shí jiān dào le zài tíng]
• When doubt hits, breathe and continue. - 怀疑来了, 深呼吸继续。  [huái yí lái le, shēn hū xī jìxù]
• You can slow down, not stop. - 可以慢一点, 但不能停。  [kě yǐ màn yì diǎn, dàn bù néng tíng]
• Do the next small task now. - 把下一件小事做完。  [bǎ xià yì jiàn xiǎo shì zuò wán]

MINDFULNESS · 正念
• Breathe in, soften your focus - 呼气时放松注意力  [hū qì shí fàng sōng zhù yì lì]
• Feel your hands, right where they are - 感受双手就在这里  [gǎn shòu shuāng shǒu jiù zài zhè lǐ]
• Let your eyes rest, quietly - 让眼睛安静地休息  [ràng yǎn jīng ān jìng de xiū xī]
• Hear your room, not your worries - 听见房间的声音，别被烦恼牵走  [tīng jiàn fáng jiān de shēng yīn, bié bèi fán nǎo qiān zǒu]
• Notice warmth where you sit - 觉察你坐着的温度  [jué chá nǐ zuò zhe de wēn dù]
• Count slow steps, one by one - 慢慢数步子，一步一步  [màn man shù bù zi, yī bù yī bù]

HOBBIES & FREE TIME · 爱好与休闲
• I hit the climbing gym twice a month. - 我每个月去两次攀岩馆。  [wo meI ge yue qu liang ci pan yan guan]
• I journal at night, just for me. - 我晚上写日记，只写给自己。  [wo wan shang xie ri ji, zhi xie gei zi ji]
• I try new street foods on weekends. - 周末我会去尝尝街头小吃。  [zhou mo wo hui qu chang chang jie tou xiao chi]
• I play soft piano to calm down. - 我弹点柔和的钢琴，放松一下。  [wo dan dian rou he de gang qin, fang song yi xia]
• I collect vintage teacups from markets. - 我从集市淘旧茶杯来收藏。  [wo cong ji shi tao jiu cha bei lai shou cang]
• I watch sunrise from a quiet spot. - 我会找个安静的地方看日出。  [wo hui zhao ge an jing de di fang kan ri chu]

INNER PEACE · 内心平静
• I breathe, then let it pass. - 我呼气，然后让它过去。  [wǒ hū qì, rán hòu ràng tā guò qù.]
• My worries don't get the steering wheel. - 烦恼不再掌舵我。  [fán nǎo bù zài zhǎng duò wǒ.]
• I choose one kind thought right now. - 我现在选一个善念。  [wǒ xiàn zài xuǎn yí gè shàn niàn.]
• I soften my grip on outcomes. - 我放松对结果的执着。  [wǒ fàng sōng duì jié guǒ de zhí zhuó.]
• Let your chest feel open and steady. - 让胸口更开阔、更踏实。  [ràng xiōng kǒu gèng kāi kuò, gèng tà shí.]
• I talk to myself with warmth. - 我用温柔的语气对自己说话。  [wǒ yòng wēn róu de yǔ qì duì zì jǐ shuō huà.]

SELF IMPROVEMENT · 自我提升
• Get comfortable being uncomfortable - 舒服一点点，挑战再多一点  [SHU FU YI DIAN DIAN, TIAO ZHAN ZAI DUO YI DIAN]
• Mindset first, then action - 先换想法，再动手做  [XIAN HUAN XIANG FA, ZAI DONG SHOU ZUO]
• Make room for focus - 给自己腾出安静的空间  [GEI ZI JI TENG CHU AN JING DE KONG JIAN]
• One sentence, then breathe - 先讲一句，停一下再继续  [XIAN JIANG YI JU, TING YI XIA ZAI JI XU]
• Stop chasing perfection, start clarity - 把问题说清楚，比猜更重要  [BA WEN TI SHUO QING CHU, BI CAI GENG ZHONG YAO]
• Turn feedback into fuel - 把别人的建议当成燃料  [BA BIE REN DE JIAN YI DANG CHENG RAN LIAO]

DAILY ROUTINE · 日常生活
• I drink water before coffee. - 我在咖啡之前先喝点水。  [Wo ZAI ka_fei ZHI_QIAN xian HE dian shui.]
